responseTime.title: Response Time (s)
responseTime.tooltip: How long the mod takes to null the velocity error. Higher is gentler.

deadband.title: Deadband (m/s)
deadband.tooltip: Velocity error below this commands no thrust. Prevents chattering.

minFuelFraction.title: Minimum Fuel Fraction
minFuelFraction.tooltip: Orbiter Mode cuts out below this much remaining fuel.

engageDistanceThreshold.title: Engage Distance Threshold (m)
engageDistanceThreshold.tooltip: Orbiter Mode can only be engaged within this distance (in meters) of the target body. Does not affect an already-engaged orbit.

showOrbitTrajectory.title: Show Orbit Trajectory Ring
showOrbitTrajectory.tooltip: Faintly draws the circular orbit path being held around the target body.

orbitAxisRotationSpeed.title: Orbit Axis Rotation Speed (deg/s)
orbitAxisRotationSpeed.tooltip: How fast holding the Rotate Orbit Axis keys tilts the orbital plane.
